Lamine and Flick after the game.

🚨🎙️| Hansi Flick: “This is always the case with a club like Barcelona. You’re always aiming to win the big titles, and Champions League is a big goal for us. We also want to win La Liga.” #fcblive
𝐅𝐝𝐉 𝟑𝟎𝟎 🎩

🚨🎙️| Hansi Flick: “We still have work to do, but the entire team was outstanding. We stayed close together, maintained great unity and defended brilliantly, especially in the space in front of our goalkeeper. It was a fantastic collective performance.” #fcblive
🚨🎙️| Hansi Flick on Rodri: "He felt some muscle discomfort and we have to wait until tomorrow." #fcblive

🚨🎙️| Hansi Flick: "Clean sheet? I'm really happy about it because we defended against a very good attack from Aston Villa. We were very solid, everyone contributed, and that's the most important thing when defending." #fcblive

🚨🎙️| Unai Emery: We faced one of the top contenders to win the tournament, and there were periods in the match where we felt we could reach that level. But it's also logical that Barcelona will always be Barcelona." #fcblive
🚨🎙️| Raphinha: “Honestly, the news hit me very hard. I spoke to my wife this morning after finding out, and I was feeling really down. It wasn’t easy to process what had happened.” #fcblive

🚨🎙️| Raphinha: “He was a fellow professional, and something like this could happen to any of us, including me or any player stepping onto the pitch today. Knowing he was around my age made it even harder to take. Personally, it affected me deeply.” #fcblive
🚨🎙️| Hansi Flick: "Fariñas was bit fatigued at the end, so we wanted to substitute him." #fcblive
